title: London Family Adventure: Pixar, Harry Potter, Dinosaurs & Minecraft
summary: A two-day London itinerary designed for a family of four with children aged 7 and 11 who love Pixar movies, Harry Potter books, Minecraft, and dinosaurs. The trip blends kid-friendly museums, iconic landmarks, and interactive experiences with halal food options and convenient prayer stops at local mosques.
tips: Use an Oyster card or contactless payment for easy travel on London's public transport.
Check museum websites for free family activities and book timed entry slots where possible.
Carry a small prayer mat for convenience during mosque visits.
